item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 02/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A hot southerly airstream will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong today. Meanwhile, the trough of low pressure over the northern part of southern China will edge closer to the coastal areas. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually in the latter part of this week, showers will ease off and the weather will be hot over Guangdong.
